content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I want to download a project from [product_name] Web Editor to a PLC. According to the instructions on page 51, it states: "To download your project, you also need a PC cable, SD card or ethernet cable for connecting the PC interface to your [product_name] device." This suggests that any of these options can be used for program download. However, when I attempt to proceed, I receive a message saying the SD card cannot be found. My question is: Is it possible to download a project from [product_name] Web Editor to a PLC without using an SD card in the device? Looking forward to your response. Thank you.
No, it's not possible to do that without an mSD card. The project from [product_name] Web Editor gets saved onto the mSD card rather than being stored in the PLC's program memory.
Understood, thank you very much. Hope you have a great weekend.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked whether it's possible to download a project from [product_name] Web Editor to a PLC without needing an SD card. Responses clarified that the SD card (specifically mSD type) is necessary because the project is saved only on the mSD card and not on the PLC’s program memory. This requirement limits the options for transferring projects flexibly.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected more flexibility when transferring projects from [product_name] Web Editor to a PLC, wishing to use various connection methods without depending on an SD card.
